elements.name: intro
elements.html:
Teaching {module} Self-paced Online Professional Learning

Post-Module Survey

Code.org relies on surveys as a crucial tool to stay connected to teachers, gather feedback about our curriculum and your teaching experience, and to improve our programs.

Privacy and Confidentiality

  • Your individual responses here are completely confidential.
  • Your identity will never be revealed publicly or used to tie any responses back to you personally.
  • We may share anonymous, aggregate data (representing all responses) publicly.
  • Your anonymized responses will be used by Code.org for program improvement.

Your honesty and candor are appreciated.

Teaching {module}: Post-Module Survey

elements.name: section1_goals
elements.html: The questions in this section aim to understand your experience with the Teaching {module} self-paced professional learning module.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_designing_building_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in navigating the AI Foundations curriculum, identifying foundational AI concepts, and understanding best practices for managing AI in the classroom.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_ai_generated_design
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students with human-centered design practices; foundational web development skills using AI to build HTML & CSS; and with visual planning using sitemaps and wireframes for accessibility & responsive design.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_ai_algorithmic_decisions
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students’ understanding of event-driven programming; visual planning with flowcharts as tools for mapping algorithms and predicting program behavior; and foundational JavaScript skills.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_building_data_driven_systems_with_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students’ understanding of arrays, objects, and schemas in real-world data; modeling core data-structure skills; and common array and object operations.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_iterating_with_ai
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students’ understanding of iteration and loops; using loops to create interactive features such as filters, searches, and views; and using AI-generated scaffolds that emphasize accountability in data choices and code.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_designing_reliable_apps
elements.visibleIf: {module} = 'Designing Reliable Apps with AI and APIs'
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students using JavaScript to get data from external APIs; understanding of APIs; and understanding of local data versus API data.

elements.name: comfort_supporting_students_learn_web_apps_with_ai_capstone
elements.title: After completing this module, I am more comfortable in my ability to support students in designing and building a complete web app with a clear purpose and audience; and in understanding the ethical implications of their application.
